# Alexey Konyakhin

Fractional CPO for founder-led software companies. Alexey takes ownership of product direction, priorities and delivery alongside the client's existing team, so the important work moves without every decision coming back to the founder. For companies with paying customers and an in-house development team; EU and UK first, with US East Coast mornings also workable.

## Location and languages

- Based in Belgrade, Serbia, on Central European Time.
- Working languages: English and Serbian.
- Invoicing in EUR from a registered business in Serbia.
- Product and engineering work since 2013.

## Engagement

A paid first month comes first: agree the business problem, look at the evidence the company already has, and set one priority with clear owners and a practical plan. If it fits, the work continues month by month as fractional CPO: product direction, trade-offs, dependencies across product, engineering and operations, and keeping the work tied to the agreed goal. Baseline and success criteria are set up front; at each checkpoint the engagement continues, changes scope, or finishes with a clean handover. Days per week and scope are agreed individually.

Alexey owns product direction, priorities, trade-offs, stakeholder alignment and measurement. The founder or CEO owns the business goal, budget, access and decision authority. The CTO and team own technical quality, estimates and day-to-day execution. Not included: unlimited development, round-the-clock availability, an agency team, or guaranteed results.

## Work

### Employee app for a major retail chain

Head of product for the whole app (retail, Russia). Alexey owned the product: direction, priorities, research, delivery and measurement. He led developers, a designer and QA, and brought hypotheses and decisions to senior stakeholders. The app had more than 300,000 monthly active users during his time on the product. A recruitment journey he led, which opened the app to people who were not yet employees so candidates for cashier and store roles could apply directly, received 20,000 job applications in its first three months.

He led the team's implementation of the full analytics stack: event coverage in Firebase, a pipeline into BigQuery, and custom Looker dashboards that gave senior managers visibility into how the workforce used the app. He also shaped an employee's idea into an in-app learning game on existing training content and piloted it across 16 operational clusters.

### Copix, mobile printing network

Product work with the founding team (Russia, 2024 to 2026). Website: https://copix.app/. Alexey worked with the team on the mobile customer journey, refunds for failed prints and the feedback loop from support back into product. Between April 2024 and June 2026, monthly card turnover grew about 3 times and turnover per active printer grew 2.15 times. These are network-wide results during the collaboration, alongside pricing and network changes.

Three companies co-founded between 2015 and 2022.
